description.value:
Your gain the service of a young animal companion that travels with you on your adventures and obeys any simple commands you give it to the best of its abilities. The companion must be of the type matching your heritage.

If you have Lycan Familiar, you may have your familiar grow into the companion and immediately retrain your Lycan Familiar ancestry feat.

This leads to @UUID[Compendium.FVTT_Pf2eAALycanthrope.feats.udA5RP6S8wZpFJJq]

Note for Murine Lycanthropes Use the Capybara statblock for your Rat companion.

Note for Selachine Lycanthropes Sharks have the aquatic trait. They are unable to survive out of water.

Note for FoundryVTT You can use the PF2e Companion Compendia module to create companions easier.
